seo.title: Member portal — TripAgent
seo.description: Your advisor, your trips, your documents — in one private place. It begins on WhatsApp, with a person who knows you.

hero.lede: It begins on WhatsApp, with a named advisor who holds it all — your trips, your documents, the way you like to travel. The web home, in build now, keeps the record.

intro.note: Not a tool you operate. The place where you see what is already kept for you.
intro.statementHtml: Nothing to log into. Nothing to manage.
intro.lede: Your advisor holds it all — the trips, the documents, the details remembered. Nothing to download, no password to keep. One thread, one person, everything in its place.

what.heading: Your advisor, your trips, your papers — one quiet record.

items.heading: Your named advisor
items.body: One person who knows you, in one thread — day or night, on the number you already use. Not a queue, not a bot.

items.heading: Your trips
items.body: Flights, hotels and visas sequenced into a single itinerary that holds together — so a change to one leg never quietly breaks the rest.

items.heading: Your documents
items.body: Passports, visas, tickets and vouchers, held safely and attached to the right trip — never hunted for in an old inbox, never re-sent.

items.heading: Your travellers
items.body: Family and companions — names as on passports, document numbers, the small preferences — remembered, so a trip for four is as simple as one.

items.heading: Your preferences
items.body: Seat and cabin, the hotel room you favour, dietary and quiet requests — kept on file and applied without your having to ask again.

items.heading: Your history
items.body: Every trip, every fare, every choice you have made with us — recallable in a line, so the next journey begins from what you already know.

begins.heading: It begins on WhatsApp.
begins.lede: The advisor is the product, not the app around it. No forms. No login. One message to someone who already knows you — and it's in motion. Everything a portal would show, your advisor already holds; the web home only opens a window onto it.

sig.headingHtml:
Held for good.
Carried quietly into everything that follows.
sig.lede: No detail typed twice, no scan re-sent, no one explained again. The next journey begins from what you already know.

remembers.heading: And it remembers.
remembers.lede: Most travel is arranged from scratch each time — the same details, the same scans, the same person explained again. A membership is the opposite. What you tell us once is held for good, and carried quietly into everything that follows.
items: Preferences carried from trip to trip — seat, cabin, room and the rest applied without being asked for.
Documents you never re-send — passports and visas held once, attached to each trip as it needs them.
An advisor who knows your last trip — and begins the next one from there, not from a blank page.

uses.heading: A message, and it is held.
uses.lede: The whole of it fits in four small motions — and three of them happen on your advisor's side, not yours.

steps.heading: Message your advisor
steps.body: One line on WhatsApp — where, when, who, and how you like to travel.

steps.heading: See your options
steps.body: Two or three considered choices come back — flights, hotels, visas, sequenced — never a wall of results.

steps.heading: It is confirmed and filed
steps.body: Your advisor holds, confirms and tickets it, and files every document against the trip.

steps.heading: Look back any time
steps.body: Ask for any past trip, fare or document in a line — and, soon, see it gathered in your web home.

inbuild.heading: The web member home is being built.
inbuild.lede: A private, signed-in place to see everything your advisor already holds — your trips, documents, travellers and preferences, on one quiet screen. It arrives in stages, and we would rather it be exact than early. Nothing waits on it: your full membership already lives on WhatsApp, with your advisor. The screen simply gathers it in one view.

items.question: Do I have to download an app?
items.answerHtml: No. Nothing to download, nothing to manage. TripAgent lives where you already are — one WhatsApp thread with a named advisor. You send a message; the rest is handled. A membership means fewer things to operate, not more.

items.question: Is there a login?
items.answerHtml: Not yet, by design. Your whole membership lives in your WhatsApp thread — no password, no portal to remember. The web home is in build and will give you a private, signed-in view of the same record. Until then, your advisor holds it all.

items.question: Where are my documents kept?
items.answerHtml: Passports, visas, tickets and vouchers are held securely by your advisor and attached to your trips — never hunted for in old email, never re-sent. They are held only to arrange your travel, and shared with airlines, hotels and consulates strictly as a booking requires.

items.question: Can my family be on my account?
items.answerHtml: Yes. Your membership holds family and regular companions — names as on passports, document numbers, seat and room preferences — so a trip for four is as simple as one. Your advisor remembers who travels with you. Nothing is explained twice.

items.question: What if I change advisor?
items.answerHtml: Your record moves with you, not the person. Your trips, documents and preferences are held by the maison, so a new advisor picks up exactly where the last left off — your history, your travellers, the way you like to travel. The thread continues; only the name at the other end changes.

items.question: Is my data private?
items.answerHtml: Yes. Your passport, payment and travel details are held only to arrange your travel, shared strictly as a booking requires, and never sold. Your advisor is bound to discretion. The detail is in our privacy policy.

items.question: Is the portal included?
items.answerHtml: Yes. The portal is part of membership — the member home, the record your advisor keeps, and the documents held for you. The full membership is set out on the membership page.

items.question: When is the web portal live?
items.answerHtml: In build now, arriving in stages — first your trips and documents, then preferences and travellers. We would rather it be exact than early. Nothing waits on it: your full membership already works, where you use it every day. For word when it opens, simply ask.

cta.headingHtml:
One place. One person.
One thread that holds it all.
